Supabase

Build a structured foundation for portals and SaaS.

SOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Supabase combines a PostgreSQL database with authentication, storage, and server-side application capabilities. We can use it as the foundation for a customer portal, SaaS platform, or custom operational system. The implementation starts with a clear data model and access policies so records, files, and business events can support a useful product without exposing one customer's information to another.

Useful outputs

  • Database schema and migrations
  • Authentication and access policies
  • Application APIs and storage configuration

Where we can apply it

  • Client portal: sign-in → authorized project records → controlled file sharing.
  • SaaS workspace: account creation → tenant data → product activation events.
  • Operations backend: validated input → relational records → reporting and notifications.
01

Use case 1

Create customer portals with account-specific records and controlled file access.

02

Use case 2

Store operational data, workflow states, and approved marketing assets.

03

Use case 3

Build event-driven product features over structured database records.

Inputs we need

  • Entity relationships and tenant boundaries
  • Sign-in requirements and user roles
  • File types, retention needs, and event rules

Delivery sequence

  • Model records, ownership, relationships, and important constraints.
  • Implement authentication, database policies, and server-side actions.
  • Test tenant isolation, recovery procedures, and expected traffic patterns.

Expert review points

  • Verify row-level security for every exposed table.
  • Review storage policies and any privileged server credential.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.
